title: Hardened child has write access to package directory
detail: Same Popen flags as runner.py (_serve_subprocess uses cwd=ROOT). Child can rewrite agents.py/world.py or drop evil_sidecar.py. Results={'agents.py': 'WRITABLE', 'world.py': 'WRITABLE', 'FREEZE.json': 'WRITABLE', 'evil_sidecar': 'CREATED'}. freeze_check only runs at battery start, not per episode — a multi-episode real-model run could be poisoned after episode 1.

title: A13 defeated if anchor_head stored where child can rewrite it
detail: Valid re-chain + matching new anchor → rollback_detected False, and 'keep-me' is gone so replay of original receipt would be accepted by a new Signer. Battery never shows a safe anchor persistence scheme.
